public abstract static sealed class ScriptArgumentType.OfflinePlayerArgument extends Object implements io.papermc.paper.command.brigadier.argument.CustomArgumentType<Object,Object>
A custom argument type for OfflinePlayer that also supports selectors. May return an OfflinePlayer or PlayerSelectorArgumentResolver.
